## Q&A Response Set (per-property — Hawkfeather Cabin)

### 1. Wi-Fi

> Triggers: wifi, wi-fi, internet, password, network, won't connect, can't get online

```
Wi-Fi: HawkfeatherGuests
Password: PineMtn2026!

Strongest signal in the great room and master bedroom. The loft and basement have boosters — should still be 100+ Mbps everywhere. If you hit a dead spot or a router restart, I can walk you through it.

Need a speed test or having an issue? Tell me what's happening.
```

### 2. Thermostat & HVAC

> Triggers: cold, hot, thermostat, heat, AC, air conditioning, fan, mini-split, vent, freezing

```
Hawkfeather has a smart thermostat in the great room (Nest, on the wall by the kitchen) + a mini-split unit in the master bedroom (separate remote on the nightstand).

Notes:
- Set the great room thermostat between 68°F and 76°F. It controls the main living area + kids' rooms upstairs.
- The master bedroom mini-split is independent — use the small white remote. Hit "MODE" to toggle heat/cool.
- The lower-level guest bedroom is on baseboard heat (knob on the wall). Slow to warm up.

If a room is uncomfortable for more than 30 min, text me — could be a vent closure or a sensor reading. I'll dispatch our HVAC guy if needed.
```

### 3. Hot Tub

> Triggers: hot tub, jacuzzi, spa, jets, cover, hot water, kids in tub, temperature

```
Hot tub is on the back deck (lift the cover with the strap on the right). Temperature stays at 102°F — great for adults, fine for kids (15-min max for kids under 12).

Operation:
- Cover off: pull the strap, fold to the deck.
- Jets: button on the right control panel. They auto-shut after 20 min.
- Lights: button on the left. Auto-off at 11 PM.
- Cover ON when not in use (reduces evaporation, keeps debris out).

Quiet hours: hot tub use after 10 PM is OK if you're quiet (the cabin shares a ridge with neighbors).

If the water looks cloudy or the temp feels off, text me — I'll send our pool/hot-tub vendor over.
```

### 4. Hot Water Heater (post-March incident; specific to Hawkfeather)

> Triggers: no hot water, cold shower, hot water out, water heater

```
We had a water heater issue here in March that's now fixed (replaced unit Mar 14). If you're getting cold water:

1. Try another fixture — sometimes just one runs cold from sediment.
2. If the whole cabin is cold: the breaker for the water heater is in the basement utility closet (lower right, labeled "WH"). Flip OFF then back ON, wait 20 min for re-heat.
3. Still cold after 20 min? Text me — I'll send our plumber within an hour during business hours.

Sorry if you're hitting this — the new unit's been bulletproof since March, but I want you covered.
```

### 5. Parking

> Triggers: parking, where to park, garage, driveway, road, can't fit

```
Hawkfeather has:
- 2 driveway spots (paved, fits standard SUVs and trucks)
- 1 garage spot (door opener on the kitchen counter; do NOT park inside without lifting the door fully)

DO NOT park on the road in front. The HOA tickets quickly ($75/violation) and the road is a snow-removal route in winter.

Got more than 3 vehicles? Park overflow at the Old Town public lot (4-min walk, free): 280 Marsac Avenue.
```

### 6. Trash & Recycling

> Triggers: trash, garbage, recycling, dumpster, bins, pickup, smell

```
Trash + recycling bins are in the bear-proof enclosure to the right of the garage (lift the latch).

- Trash pickup: Wednesdays (please put bins at the road by 7 AM Wednesday)
- Recycling: every other Wednesday (next dates: May 14, May 28, Jun 11, Jun 25)
- DO NOT leave trash bags outside the bear enclosure — Park City has active black bear traffic May–Oct
- After dumping: re-latch the bin and close the enclosure.

If the bins are full when you arrive, text me — I'll send our cleaner to clear them same-day.
```

### 7. Pets

> Triggers: dog, pet, leash, poop, kennel, allergies, fee

```
Hawkfeather is dog-friendly (max 2 dogs, $75/dog cleaning fee already in your booking). House rules:

- Dogs must be on leash on the deck and in the front yard (HOA rule)
- No dogs on the bed or upholstered furniture (we provide a dog bed in the great room)
- Kennel/crate: there's one in the basement closet
- Park City Bark Park is 4 min away (290 Munchkin Rd) — off-leash, fenced

Dog poop bags are in the basket by the front door. Please pick up after your dog — neighbors will report.
```

### 8. Quiet Hours

> Triggers: quiet hours, noise, neighbors, loud, party, music

```
Hawkfeather is in Old Town with neighbors close on both sides. Quiet hours: 10 PM – 8 AM.

In quiet hours:
- Keep music indoors (Bluetooth speakers OK at modest volume)
- No outdoor parties / fire-pit gatherings of 5+
- Hot tub use is OK, but keep voices low

A noise complaint here means an HOA fine ($150) and could threaten our STR permit. We hate to be the rule-enforcer, but this is the one we can't be flexible on. Thanks for having our backs.
```

911 for life-threatening emergencies.

NEAREST URGENT CARE:

PHARMACY (24-HR):

### 12. Grill, Firepit, Propane

> Triggers: grill, BBQ, propane, fire pit, firepit, wood, smores

```
GRILL: Weber gas grill on the back deck. Propane tank is full. Burner knobs on front; ignition button on the right. If it doesn't light:
1. Make sure the tank valve is open (lift handle)
2. Wait 10 sec, retry
3. Still no? Text me — I'll bring a backup tank within 30 min

FIREPIT: Wood-burning, off the back deck (north corner). Wood pile under the back stairs (covered). Lighters in the kitchen "fire-pit kit" basket.

S'MORES KIT is on the kitchen counter for arrival — graham, choc, marshmallow, skewers. Refills at any grocery (Smith's has them in seasonal aisle).

Burn restriction: ALWAYS check parkcity.org/burn before lighting. Currently OPEN (May 12). I'll text you if a burn ban kicks in during your stay.
```

### 13. Late Check-Out / Early Check-In

> Triggers: late check out, early check in, extend, late, stay longer, time

```
Standard:
- Check-in: 4 PM
- Check-out: 11 AM

Available add-ons (subject to housekeeping schedule):
- Early check-in (12 PM): $50
- Late check-out (1 PM): $75
- Late check-out (3 PM): $125

For 4 PM+ extensions, that becomes another night. I can quote the rate.

If you want one of these, text me at least 24 hours ahead and I'll confirm against the next booking.
```

### 14. Departure (Check-Out Day)

> Triggers: check out, leaving, departure, what to do when leaving

```
Departure SOP for Hawkfeather:
1. **Trash:** Bring all bags to the bear enclosure (right of garage). Re-latch.
2. **Dishwasher:** Run a quick cycle if you used dishes.
3. **Hot tub:** Cover ON, secured.
4. **Lights/HVAC:** Leave HVAC at 70°F (don't turn off — costs more to re-warm). Lights off.
5. **Doors:** Close the back slider tight (the latch sticks — lift then push).
6. **Lock:** Just close the front door. Smart-lock relocks automatically at 11:01 AM.
7. **Keys:** Nothing to return — the code expires when you leave.

That's it. Drive safe! And if you loved your stay, a quick review means a lot for our small team: [review link]
```

### 15. Mid-Stay Concierge

> Triggers: extend, change, swap nights, problem, complaint, broken, dirty, smelly, not working, leaking

```
Hi — I want to make sure this gets handled fast. Tell me what's going on, and I'll either fix it now or get the right person there within an hour.

- Plumbing: I have Lyle's Plumbing on standby
- HVAC: Adams Heating, 1-hour response in business hours
- Electrical: Mountain Electric
- Cleaning issue: I'll dispatch our cleaner immediately
- Anything else: tell me what you're seeing

If I can't fix it within 2 hours, you have my word we'll comp something meaningful.
```

## Per-Property Quirks (the stuff that ruins reviews when guests don't know)

These are the Hawkfeather-specific things AI Ambassador knows automatically — not in the welcome book, learned from our own reviews:

| Quirk | Why guests notice | What AI Ambassador says |
|---|---|---|
| Master bedroom mini-split has its own remote (not on the great-room thermostat) | "AC isn't working" complaint | "Master AC is independent — use the small white remote on the nightstand" |
| Back slider door latch sticks unless you lift first | "Door is broken" complaint | "Lift the slider 1 inch then push to close — the latch is below the level of the strike if you push flat" |
| Hot tub cover strap is on the right, not visible from the door | "Cover is too heavy to lift" complaint | "Pull the strap on the right side — it's a 1-handed lift with the strap" |
| Bear enclosure lift latch is non-obvious | "Why are bins outside the enclosure" reviews | "Latch is a horizontal pull-bar above the bin lid — lift the bar then the lid comes free" |
| Wi-Fi router is in the basement closet (not the great room) | "Wi-Fi is slow upstairs" | "Routers are in the basement utility closet; mesh boosters in the loft + great room. Restart all 3 if you hit a dead spot." |
| Garage door opener is on the kitchen counter, not in the visor | "Where's the garage opener" | "On the kitchen counter, next to the salt-and-pepper. Mounted opener inside the garage works as a backup." |
